cards.stem: Which symbol represents the coefficient term in this relation
cards.hint: Look for the symbol on the right side of the relation

cards.stem: Which property of the air contributes to drag in the dependence description
cards.quote: Drag depends on the density of the air, the square of the velocity, the air’s viscosity and compressibility
cards.hint: It is listed together with velocity squared

cards.stem: How is the area term in this relation described
cards.quote: Notice that the area (A) given in the drag equation is given as a reference area.
cards.hint: The phrase indicates a chosen representative size

cards.stem: What name is given to the quantity formed by density times square of velocity divided by two
cards.quote: The combination of terms “density times the square of the velocity divided by two” is called the dynamic pressure
cards.hint: This term appears in Bernoulli pressure relations
